knobs.name: pullT0
knobs.what: s: camera pulls back from the macro to the wide plan

knobs.name: numsAt
knobs.what: s: case counts rise under the plate names

knobs.name: litT0
knobs.what: s: passing cubes start to light

knobs.name: cPctAt
knobs.what: s: first ratio lands (after its count)

knobs.name: cNoneAt
knobs.what: s: words callout on a dark column

knobs.name: cAllAt
knobs.what: s: words callout on a full column

knobs.name: m2T0
knobs.what: s: M2 starts: re-sort by builds that passed

knobs.name: in0T0
knobs.what: s: camera pushes in on the dark band

knobs.name: to6T0
knobs.what: s: camera pans to the full band

knobs.name: out6T0
knobs.what: s: camera pulls out to the medium skyline

knobs.name: ghostT0
knobs.what: s: the luck roofs start to arrive, band by band

knobs.name: luckAt
knobs.what: s: the two luck pins enter

knobs.name: m3T0
knobs.what: s: M3 starts: cut plane rises to six of six

knobs.name: cPctFullAt
knobs.what: s: the share lands (after its count)

knobs.name: j1T0
knobs.what: s: J1 starts: telecom leaves for its plate, camera travels

knobs.name: m4aT0
knobs.what: s: M4a starts: re-stack into six tanks by build

knobs.name: pinBAt
knobs.what: s: pins on the lowest and highest tank enter

knobs.name: m4bT0
knobs.what: s: M4b starts: re-partition into three tanks by kind

knobs.name: pinKAt
knobs.what: s: pins on the kind tanks enter

knobs.name: j3T0
knobs.what: s: J3 starts: camera travels to the board carrying the plane

knobs.name: c53At
knobs.what: s: task count and plate pins enter

knobs.name: pinsBdEnd
knobs.what: s: plate and ruler pins leave

knobs.name: slabT0
knobs.what: s: slabs rise to the best build's scores

knobs.name: bestT0
knobs.what: s: the plane rises from zero to the best build's mean

knobs.name: ghostBT0
knobs.what: s: the expert's ghost slabs rise

knobs.name: expT0
knobs.what: s: the expert's plane starts to descend

knobs.name: pushBT0
knobs.what: s: camera pushes in on the banking slab

knobs.name: j4T0
knobs.what: s: J4 starts: camera travels to the call sheet

knobs.name: askT0
knobs.what: s: the questions to the client light

knobs.name: monT0
knobs.what: s: camera tilts to the Monday view

knobs.name: seedAsk
knobs.what: seed: cell of a question inside its build's block

knobs.name: swayU
knobs.what: share of a move when the sway starts

knobs.name: landU
knobs.what: share of a move at its visual landing (ring beat)

knobs.name: cutDim
knobs.what: dim of columns below the cut

knobs.name: hold
knobs.what: frames a label must be pushed before it hides

knobs.name: numWt
knobs.what: weight beat on a landed number
